data.name: Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box
data.headline: This Diwali, gift something they'll actually use.
data.benefit: This Diwali, skip the 14th dry-fruit box. Gift 3 classes for the price of 2. If they join, you get a bonus class too.
data.rationale: Gifting is real festive spend; the 3-for-2 gets recipients to the 3-visit mark that converts at 73–89%.
data.conditions: Recipient must be new; activate within 60 days. Claim by 2027-11-15.
data.kpi: Gift envelopes sold; activation rate; recipient → member.

data.name: Diwali Cleaning: Found Your Old Grip Socks?
data.headline: Diwali cleaning found your old grip socks. Sign?
data.benefit: Diwali cleaning found your old grip socks. That's a sign. Bring them back: 15% off your return and a brand-new pair on us.
data.rationale: A physical prompt from the client's own home is a memorable trigger; the retail cost is low.

data.name: Same Time Next Week
data.headline: Your pack is nearly out. Same one again, 15% less.
data.benefit: You're nearly out of classes. Take the same pack again at 15% off — ₹7,229 for ten at Copper + Cloves, ₹5,891 for eight — and we’ll add a week of validity so none of them go to waste.
data.rationale: The pop-ups sell class packs, not memberships, so renewal is a repurchase decision rather than an expiry date. Four of the twelve months carried a renewal target with no renewal offer in the catalogue; this is the standing one.
data.audience: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.
data.conditions: 15% off the pack, inside the cap. One per client per pack expiry. The extra week of validity has no cash value.
data.kpi: Packs repurchased within 14 days of running out (target 55%); share of pop-up renewal revenue with an offer behind it.
